parameters.atmosphere: CO2 and SF6 with volume ratio 99:1
parameters.cooling_method: cast into steel mold and cooled

evidence.quote: After these materials were heated to 760 /C14 C for 10 min, the molten alloy was cast into a steel mold with diameter of F 80 mm and cooled to form GW84 ingot.
The disc plate samples with F 50 /C2 45 mm were cut from the ingots, which were heated at 525 /C14 C for 8 h and then quenched into cold water.
Before extrusion, the samples were hold at 500 /C14 C for 30 min

the extrusion process parameters were as follows: extrusion ratio l ¼ 10, extrusion speed, v ¼ 0.2 m/s, forming F 15 mm cylindrical bars. Then the extruded bars were quenched into cold water immediately.
After aging treatment (T5) for 200 /C14 C /C2 96 h, the tensile samples were cooled at room temperature, reaching peak value

parameters.cooling_method: quenched into cold water after stretching

evidence.quote: Then tensile test was carried out on SHIMADZU AG-1250 N universal testing machine with high temperature incubator at 200 /C14 C, 250 /C14 C and 300 /C14 C respectively, with the tensile speed 1 mm/min.

evidence.section: 3.2.2. TEM images of specimens stretching at 200 /C14 C
evidence.quote: Because b 0 phase has good thermal stability, which could improve high temperature tensile strength by blocking dislocation slip, pinning grain boundaries and preventing grain boundary slip.

evidence.section: 3.2.3. TEM images of specimens stretching at 250 /C14 C
evidence.quote: the transformation from b0 phase (Mg7(Gd,Y,Sm)) to b phase (Mg5(Gd,Y,Sm)) is completed within the tensile process at 250 /C14 C. We speculate that this transformation of precipitated phase is very rapid
when stretching at 250 /C14 C, the nano b0 precipitate transformed into nano b phase ( b0 / b), and the precipitation mechanism is mainly inoculation nucleation of b phase
the driving force of precipitation for b phase is larger when the alloy is stretched at 250 /C14 C and the precipitation mode of b phase is mainly nucleated
